description.value: HI Penticton is a Hostelling International hostel situated in Penticton, BC, a South Okanagan town flanked by Okanagan and Skaha Lakes that serves as a natural staging point for touring cyclists tackling the Kettle Valley Rail Trail and the surrounding wine-country routes. As part of the HI Canada network, it offers affordable shared accommodation in a region that draws cyclists from across the continent. Its downtown Ellis Street location puts guests within easy reach of the waterfront and local services.
